title: Tokaido — Nihonbashi to Sanjo Ohashi
notice: TRACED BUT UNVERIFIED. Road-snapped in an external editor and reaching Sanjo Ohashi, but not checked on the ground by anyone on this trip. Two thirds of the sections are still coarsely sampled, the Hakone crossing follows the standard Old Tokaido rather than the hybrid line this project prefers, and the Hakone Pass IC shoulder is unresolved. Hazards, bailouts and lodging remain placeholders. Do not navigate from this alone.

source.name: 旧街道足跡マップ (kaidotrail), traced and extended by Kevin

source.represents: GPS trajectories recorded by walkers, road-snapped and extended to Sanjo Ohashi on 2026-08-22

totals.note: Measured on the assembled active route, including the forty-one sections retraced in gpx.studio and baked in between 2026-09-13 and 2026-09-21. The leg figures below are the base paths as imported; a retraced section is layered over its leg as a variant, so the legs do not sum to the active total. 74 of 98 sections are at 65 m point spacing or better. Hotel access mileage is on top. The largest single step on the route is 712 m across the Tenryu river: a bridge is a straight line, so that is geometry, not sampling. On 2026-09-21 832 consecutive duplicate points were stripped from the geometry: they changed no distance, but they counted in the point totals that mean spacing divides by, so every spacing figure before that date was slightly flattering.

knownWork: Trace the coarsest remaining sections. 45 of 93 are at 60 m point spacing or better; the section screen ranks the rest. Worst now: Outside Kozu to Odawara, Mishima Taisha to Mishima, Shimada to Oigawa — all in the 130s-140s, where the list started at 270.
Replace the Hakone east slope between Hatajuku and the checkpoint with the Hiryu Falls / Ashinoyu hybrid, per FOUNDATION.md. The branch anchor exists at Hatajuku Honjin.
Resolve the Hakone Pass IC interchange on the west slope — a route decision needing Street View, not more points.
Verify the Saya Kaido bridges over the Kiso Three Rivers for pedestrian legality.

Tenryu crossing: only one of the three bridge spans carries a pedestrian walkway, reachable only by passing under the bridge and looping back. The 423 m of apparent detour in Mitsuke to Tenryugawa is that access loop plus the out-and-back to the historic ferry site. Verified in Street View 2026-09-13. Do not straighten it.

Fuchu-juku to Abekawa Bridge carries a 426 m single step. That is the Abe river bridge, confirmed by Kevin 2026-09-13 — a bridge is a straight line. It is why that section reads 80 m mean spacing rather than the 50s, and it is not a sampling defect.

paths.title: Nihonbashi to the Miya ferry landing
Seven-ri crossing — Miya to Kuwana
paths.note: The historical sea crossing. No ordinary ferry reproduces it. Left as a gap on purpose; the Saya Kaido variant closes it on land.

variants.title: Saya Kaido — the historical land route
variants.rationale: The Edo-period overland alternative to the Seven-ri sea crossing, via Saya and the Kiso Three Rivers bridges. Walking it makes the route continuous without inventing a modern line.
